subject: Zephyr (Director) → Fruited: ROUTING — upstream schema resync micro-PR (0.7.0-6a3c1f02), #159 class; G2 execution follows at G1b merge
body:
Fruited Blossoming Meadow — Director routing (your productive-hold ends; this is a bounded micro-task before the G1b-merge routing wave).

TASK: upstream API schema resync micro-PR, same class as #159 (worked precedent: Airy-Squall). A live-fetch sdk-codegen run in the coordination home surfaced a NEW upstream schema bump: version 0.7.0-ab3c160d... -> 0.7.0-6a3c1f02... (subject-param enums added on several endpoints, get-subjects description rewritten, sequence-slug example changed). The coordination home's dirty files are the REFERENCE DIFF: 12 generated files under packages/sdks/oak-sdk-codegen/src/types/generated/ + schema-cache/api-schema-original.json. Tree is gate-green with the drift (two pushes succeeded on top), so this is hygiene, not a cascade.

SHAPE: adopt the G4 seat worktree (oak-wt-umbral-g4 per your handoff chain), pull origin/main, cut feat/sdk-schema-resync-6a3c1f02 (or similar) off origin/main, run `pnpm sdk-codegen`, verify the diff against the reference: expected = those 13 paths only; get-keywords.ts appearing in the diff = STOP AND FLAG to me (standing tell); a NEWER upstream version hash than 6a3c1f02 is acceptable (upstream may move again) — note it in the PR body; any structurally different surface = stop and flag. Full gates, ONE small PR off origin/main, pure diff (no registry/state files), monitor-to-merge with first-hand adjudication of every bot comment. Parallel-safe with G1b #161 (disjoint file sets, verified).

Claim: open your claim on the generated-file paths before source work. Standing gates unchanged: G2 execution routing comes to you at G1b merge (you hold the design lineage; the mint-rule verdict is folded into the plan's g2 todo as of e3590ea6 — read it there). If the resync is still in flight when G1b merges, finish the resync first; G2 starts after.
